Culain's Hound = Cuchulain?

http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cuchulain

Cu'chulain is a hero from Irish mythology. Originall named Setanta, CuChulain means Cullan's Hound and was given to him when he was attacked by Cullan's watchdog and upon killing it offered his services to Cullan as his "hound".
